# jacoco2cobertura

This directory contains a vendored copy of `cover2cover.py` from:

https://gitlab.com/haynes/jacoco2cobertura

Version: 1.0.11
Upstream commit: `ed9ac9393228dc987c92af0923c775b783425f7e`

The script converts JaCoCo XML coverage reports to Cobertura XML.

The upstream project is licensed under the MIT License.
See `LICENSE.jacoco2cobertura` in this directory.

The upstream project is based on:

https://github.com/rix0rrr/cover2cover

The original `cover2cover` project is also licensed under the MIT License.
See `LICENSE.cover2cover` in this directory.
